units: <cite ref="Yevamot 54a:2">Yeb. 54ᵃ</cite> <he>ותְקָפַתּוֹ יבמתו</he> (not <he>ותקפתה</he>) and his sister-in-law seized (forced) him.
<cite ref="Yevamot 54a">Ib.</cite> <he>תְּקָפוּהוּ נכרים וכ׳</he> gentiles seized him, and coupled them.
<cite ref="Bava Metzia 6a:16">B. Mets. 6ᵃ</cite> <he>תְּקָפָהּ אחד בפנינו</he> if one (of the two litigants) seized it (the object in dispute) in the presence of the court.
<cite ref="Bava Metzia 6b:3">Ib.ᵇ</cite> <he>תְּקָפוֹ כהן</he> if a priest seized it (the lamb of doubtful first birth).
<cite ref="Avodah Zarah 23a:8">Ab. Zar. 23ᵃ</cite> <he>יצרו תוֹקְפוֹ</he> his passion overpowers him.

<cite ref="Midrash Tehillim 19:16">Midr. Till. to Ps. XIX, 14</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="A01653"><he>איתם</he></cite> <cite ref="Midrash Tehillim 19:16">ib.</cite>, with play on <cite ref="A01655"><he>איתן</he></cite>) <he>אלו תוֹקְפֵי עבירות</he> this refers to those who conquer sin; a. fr.

<cite ref="Pirkei Avot 3:8">Ab. III, 8</cite> <he>תָּקְפָה עליו משנתו</he> if his study was too hard for him (and therefore he forgot again what he had learned); <cite ref="Menachot 99b">Men. 99ᵇ</cite>; a. e.
